_about: Ready-made videos. A preset fills style, look, destination, aspect, duration, resolution, sound and transitions in brief.json (video.py preset); the user still gives the product photos and, where the style needs one, the model. needs: what else to ask for.

presets.name: Mannequin 360° listing video
presets.pitch: Your mannequin photo turns a full circle in front of the same background while the camera stays still. 10 s, horizontal 1080p, silent: ready for Etsy, Alibaba or a website.
needs: a photo of the garment on a mannequin (a back photo too, or the back is guessed)
scene: one line describing the photo's background

presets.name: Mannequin 360° Reel
presets.pitch: The same mannequin spin in vertical for Instagram, TikTok and Shorts. 10 s, 768p, silent (add music in the app).
needs: a photo of the garment on a mannequin (a back photo too, or the back is guessed)
scene: one line describing the photo's background

presets.name: Model 360° listing video
presets.pitch: A model turns slowly in a clean light-grey studio so buyers see every side. 10 s, horizontal 1080p, silent: the classic Etsy and Alibaba product video.
needs: front and back photos
model: AI (describe) or own (photo and consent)

presets.name: Street-style Reel
presets.pitch: A candid walk down a city street on an overcast day. 15 s vertical, 768p, with street sound.
needs: front photo (back helps)
model: AI (describe) or own (photo and consent)

presets.name: Night drop Reel
presets.pitch: Lookbook poses on a rain-wet street under neon light, for a new drop. 15 s vertical, 768p.

presets.pitch: No model: the garment floats and turns under a single spotlight on black. 10 s, horizontal 1080p, for a website hero or a launch post.

presets.name: Quality close-ups for wholesale
presets.pitch: Slow macro shots of the fabric, stitching and prints, then a floating turn. 20 s horizontal for Alibaba and B2B buyers, silent.
needs: front and back photos, plus a detail photo if they have one
detail_focus: what to show close up (e.g. embroidery, zip, seams)

presets.name: Factory story for Alibaba
presets.pitch: Cutting, stitching, printing or embroidery, a quality check, then the finished garment on a model. 30 s horizontal for Alibaba, a B2B website or LinkedIn.
needs: front and back photos
model: AI (describe) or own (photo and consent)
factory.decoration: e.g. screen printing, sublimation, embroidery
